bullets.text: YouTube's Custom Feed Launch - **YouTube** is testing a new feature to improve video recommendations based on user interests.
Affordable Bass Control - **Nothing's** CMF Headphone Pro offers intuitive bass adjustment at an impressive price point.
AirTag Enhancements for Travelers - **Apple** improves AirTag's luggage tracking feature for better airline integration.
Pocket Casts Introduces Smart Playlists - The **Pocket Casts** app now features smart playlists for easier podcast organization.
ViewSonic's Affordable 5K Display - **ViewSonic** offers a 27” 5K display for Mac users at a competitive price.
iOS 26.2 Enhances Invites App - **Apple**'s latest update simplifies event creation in the Invites app.
Uber's Driverless Robotaxi Milestone - **Uber** and **WeRide** launch fully driverless robotaxi service in Abu Dhabi.
Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 Unveiled - **Qualcomm** introduces a new chip for affordable flagship phones with enhanced performance.
AI Shopping Assistants Launch - **OpenAI** and **Perplexity** introduce AI features to enhance online shopping experiences.
Fleet Space Discovers Lithium with AI - **Fleet Space** uses AI and satellites to locate a massive lithium deposit.
